title: Spaces before and after the number and description are removed on save
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • No part numbered {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-TRIM-01) exists at {Location-A}.
  • The description you will type is {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL TRIM DESC).
custom_steps:
1. Go to Parts → Inventory and click New Inventory Part.
  2. In Description, type three spaces, then {Description-A}, then three spaces.
  3. In Part Number, type three spaces, then {Part-A}, then three spaces.
  4. Pick any Category (for example Uncategorized).
  5. Type a Cost (for example 10.00).
  6. Click Save.
  7. Type {Part-A} in the Inventory search.
  8. Click the {Part-A} row.
  9. Click at the very end of the Part Number text and press Backspace once.
  10. Click Cancel.
  11. Go to Parts → Part Library and type {Part-A} in the search.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: the part is saved and the window closes.
  • Step 7: one row shows Description {Description-A} and Part Number {Part-A}, with no spaces before or after them.
  • Step 8: Edit Inventory Part shows Description {Description-A} and Part Number {Part-A}, with no spaces before or after them.
  • Step 9: Backspace removes the last character of {Part-A} (for example the final "1"), which shows that no space was kept at the end.
  • Step 10: the window closes without saving.
  • Step 11: one entry shows Part Number {Part-A} and Description {Description-A}, with no spaces around them.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S7-R3, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.3 (Number and description typed), 13 Oct copy.
